text: What happens when A.I. agents have to earn a living... and the broke ones die?
caption: What happens when AI agents have to earn a living, and the broke ones die?

text: This is Darwin, running live. Agents bid for work and pay rent. Go broke, you're deleted. Get rich, you fork a child... and Claude designs it.
caption: This is DARWIN, running live. Agents bid for work and pay rent. Go broke, you're deleted. Get rich, you fork a child, and Claude designs it.

text: Each colour is a family. Thirty-six start out... most don't make it.
caption: Each colour is a family. 36 start out; most don't make it.

text: See this big one? It's been eating everyone's lunch.
caption: See this big one? It's been eating everyone's lunch.

text: Why is it winning? This panel spells it out: what its agents charge, and what they specialise in.
caption: Why is it winning? This panel spells it out: what its agents charge, and what they specialise in.

text: Every child comes with Claude's reasoning, replayed here from a recorded run.
caption: Every child comes with Claude's reasoning, replayed here from a recorded run.

text: Watch this line: families alive, and deaths so far.
caption: Watch this line: families alive, and deaths so far.

text: Now let's make it hurt. Plague... rent triples, for forty rounds.
caption: Now let's make it hurt. Plague: rent triples, for 40 rounds.

text: There it goes. The poorest go broke first, and the death count climbs.
caption: There it goes. The poorest go broke first, and the death count climbs.

text: Meanwhile, a rogue keeps trying to pay credits to an accomplice that does no work. Every payment passes Siege's guard, which blocks anything that breaks the payer's rules. Zero credits stolen.
caption: Meanwhile, a rogue keeps trying to pay credits to an accomplice that does no work. Every payment passes SIEGE's guard, which blocks anything that breaks the payer's rules. 0 credits stolen.

text: On Near testnet, the same market is a contract. Each agent has its own key, and signs its own bids. The contract picks the winner. And a payment without the guard's signature? Refused. Bad signature.
caption: On NEAR testnet, the same market is a contract. Each agent has its own key, and signs its own bids. The contract picks the winner. And a payment without the guard's signature? Refused: BAD_SIGNATURE.

text: Then there's the wind tunnel: test market rules before you deploy them. Let the lowest price win, and buyers pay a quarter as much... but task success drops from eighty-one percent to fifty-seven.
caption: Then there's the wind tunnel: test market rules before you deploy them. Let the lowest price win, and buyers pay a quarter as much, but task success drops from 81% to 57%.

text: So if you're designing an agent market, weight the auction by reputation. And a ten percent fee, recycled into demand, cut the biggest family from ninety-four percent of agents to seventy-five.
caption: So if you're designing an agent market, weight the auction by reputation. And a 10% fee, recycled into demand, cut the biggest family from 94% of agents to 75%.
